name: Create EM Spectrum Reference Chart
description:
Create a 4-page ActivInspire flipchart serving as a reference for the Electromagnetic Spectrum.

Structure:
1. Page 1 (Overview): Title "The Electromagnetic Spectrum" and a brief description.
2. Page 2 (Full Spectrum): A diagram with 7 colored rectangles arranged in order of wavelength. Label them: Radio, Microwave, Infrared, Visible, Ultraviolet, X-ray, Gamma. Add text labels "Long Wavelength" and "Short Wavelength" at appropriate ends.
3. Page 3 (Visible Light): A detail view with rectangles for the visible colors (Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Indigo, Violet). Include wavelength reference text (e.g., "380 nm - 700 nm").
4. Page 4 (Applications): List real-world applications for at least 4 bands (e.g., Radio: communication, Microwave: cooking, X-ray: medical imaging, Gamma: sterilization).

Save the file to: /home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/em_spectrum_reference.flipchart
